name: filesystem
description: Scoped local file access server with path boundary enforcement (pure Go, stdlib only)

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read multiple files in one call

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with the provided contents

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Exact string replacement inside a file

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Recursive JSON tree of a directory

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively match file and directory names

tools.name: get_file_info

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Show directories this server may access
